transcript.text: Before we proceed, I need to share an important finding from our department's classroom pilot. The pilot found that the OpenMath Core package requires 90 minutes of mathematics intervention per week for the planned student grouping model. This is a significant difference from the 60 minutes per week currently allocated in the draft implementation plan. I recorded this finding in the department pilot binder, but I should note that the binder has not yet been uploaded to the adoption folder. I believe this discrepancy needs to be addressed before we move forward with final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Patel. That's an important finding. Now, from the library and licensing perspective, I need to share the results of my license review for the OpenMath Core package. The license permits district modifications, but only when every modified print or digital item carries the publisher's exact attribution statement: 'Adapted from OpenMath Core.' I've completed the review, but I should note that the licensing note is still awaiting entry in the library catalog record. This attribution requirement is something we'll need to ensure is followed if the district makes any modifications to the materials.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Green. Now, from the multilingual learner perspective, I need to share an important finding from the multilingual learner family review I conducted with families. The review identified 22 enrolled eighth-grade students who need a Spanish-English mathematics glossary supplied with the core materials. I completed this review with the families, but I should note that the result is still in my consultation notes rather than the adoption form. This glossary supplement is not listed in the draft implementation plan, and I believe it needs to be included before we move forward with final approval.

transcript.text: Thank you, Ms. Torres. Now, from the finance perspective, I need to share an important finding regarding the funding for this adoption.
